release_name: Live TV v5.2.4 (Build 59) — TSN Canada & ESPN 2 Brasil HD (Paris Masters)
min_os_mac: macOS 11.0 Big Sur or later (Apple Silicon)
changelog: 🎾 Added TSN 1 HD (Rolex Paris Masters): Official Canadian broadcast delivering live center-court coverage with multi-server failover
🎾 Added ESPN 2 Brasil HD (#TênisNaESPN): Portuguese live coverage of Rolex Paris Masters tennis and premier international athletics
🎾 Added Sport Klub 4 HD (SK 4 HD): Live coverage of ATP Rolex Paris Masters tennis and European sports competitions
🎾 Added Sky Sports Main Event & Sky Sports Tennis HD: Dedicated center-court and 24/7 world tennis tournament coverage
⚽ Added Polsat Sport Premium 2 & 1 Super HD: Full UEFA Europa League & Champions League coverage with failover streams
🛡️ Resilient Multi-Server Failover: Direct match streams automatically backed by verified 24/7 CDN feeds (Tennis Channel HD, T2, beIN Sports XTRA)
⇄ Last Channel Toggle & Recall: Alternates between current and previous channels with on-screen button labels and hotkey Q
👆 Player Controls Touch & Scroll Lock: Touching or scrolling through action pills and channels will never hide controls overlay
